{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique patient_id values before deduplication
unique_patients_before = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count the number of unique patients after deduplication
unique_patients_after = df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()

# Print the result
print(unique_patients_after)"}
